## Problem and change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Identify untested platforms.

## Relevant checks

- [ ] Changes preserve private installation paths and avoid system-wide installs.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] If application or installer sources changed, installer copies and ZIP packages are synchronized.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, personal media, or sensitive logs are included.
